method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the adult whose capacity for a claim is in question, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; dates, the regulative vocabulary and the schedule 2 and 4 definitions in one shared module (built-in date functions, no daydate), then three rule modules (appointment; the administrator and remedies; tribunal proceedings and reporting), each exported question calling a rule defined beside it, and a worked-case file for each; three regulative rules (ss 21(1), 59(5)-(6), 60C(4)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Guardianship and Administration Act 2000 (Qld), act-2000-008, the version in force from 2026-04-28 (current on 2026-11-06), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2000-008.txt (text sha256 2cf579740796434ee5bcf8240e42f2e27b685c7b88a81351ef301c82523f691f per its meta.json); converted from the Queensland Legislation HTML view; no instrument brought in (none sets a number the encoded sections use)
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is (c) The State of Queensland, CC BY 4.0; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the adult whose capacity for a claim is in question (for example an injured person whose compensation claim, settlement or damages award an administrator may run or manage); for s 59 after the adult's death, the adult's estate; for ss 60, 60A and 60C a person who takes from the adult's estate; for ss 247-247C a person who reports abuse or a contravention to an official

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run <file> for each of the seven .l4 files, from this folder, at most two at a time
checks.result: 189 assertions written, 189 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: The provisions a claimant with doubtful capacity meets. In: ss 11; 12(1), (3); 13; 14(1)(b), (c); 15(2), (3); 21(1); 26(1)(a)-(f), (2)(a), (3); 28(1); 29(1)(b); 31(2)-(5); 33(2); 37; 47; 48(1)-(3); 54; 58; 59; 60; 60A(1)-(3); 60C(1), (2), (4), (5); 114B; 115; 118(1), (3), (5)-(7); 119; 123; 124(1); 125(1); 127(1), (2); 146; 147; 152; 153; 155(1), (4), (6); 156; 158; 163; 164; 239; 245; 247; 247A; 247C; sch 2 ss 1, 2, 18; sch 4 capacity, impaired capacity, paid carer, interested person. Out: chapters 1, 2, 2A (purpose and principles), 5, 5A, 5B (health care, sterilisation, restrictive practices), 6, 9, 12; missing persons (ss 12A, 12B, 27A, 27B), enduring documents (ss 22-25), the appointee's own advice and plans (ss 16-20), machinery and duties between officials, limitation orders, ss 248-249A. Reasons in NOTES.md.
